entries.title: Psalms 112:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! Blessed [is] the man [who] fears the LORD, [Who] delights greatly in His commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 112:2
segments: His descendants will be mighty on earth; The generation of the upright will be blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 112:3
segments: Wealth and riches [will be] in his house, And his righteousness endures forever.

entries.title: Psalms 112:4
segments: Unto the upright there arises light in the darkness; [He is] gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 112:5
segments: A good man deals graciously and lends; He will guide his affairs with discretion.

entries.title: Psalms 112:6
segments: ¶Surely he will never be shaken; The righteous will be in everlasting remembrance.

entries.title: Psalms 112:7
segments: He will not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 112:8
segments: His heart [is] established; He will not be afraid, Until he sees [his desire] upon his enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 112:9
segments: He has dispersed abroad, He has given to the poor; His righteousness endures forever; His horn will be exalted with honor.

entries.title: Psalms 112:10
segments: The wicked will see [it] and be grieved; He will gnash his teeth and melt away; The desire of the wicked shall perish.
